description: Fresh privileged-state sanity checks; not a re-evaluation of archived neural models.

protocol.mixed_random_actions: iid per step; deliberately not collector burst sampling
protocol.counterfactual: 10 iid uniform actions from heldout noisy-expert states, shared across conditions
protocol.fit: unregularized least-squares affine delta; train-only feature standardization; clip predicted positions
protocol.units: position and target: unit-square coordinates; velocity normalized by 0.05 in state; velocity_raw_mse multiplies normalized error by 0.05 before squaring
protocol.uncertainty: mean and sample standard deviation across fresh collection seeds; not confidence intervals; no neural model results
